meta.name: English
app.name: OREVOSH
app.tagline: Your looks. Your people. Your brands.
lang.label: Language
auth.handle_hint: 2 to 40 letters, numbers, dots or underscores. People find you by it.
auth.privacy: Checks are private until you post them. Nothing is public until you say so.
auth.signup_intro: Check your look with a stylist. Post it. Get fire. Meet the brands you wear.
auth.login_intro: Sign in to check, post, react and vote.
auth.required_body: Checks, fire, comments and votes need an account. Browsing doesn't.
welcome.title: Welcome to OREVOSH
welcome.styles_hint: Pick a few. Your feed starts here, and you can change it any time in settings.
welcome.brands_hint: Follow a few and their looks and challenges land in your feed.
feed.title: Home
feed.empty: Nothing here yet. Be the first to post a look.
feed.empty_following: Follow people and brands and their looks show up here.
feed.following_locked: Sign in to see the people you follow.
explore.title: Explore
explore.empty: Explore fills up as people post looks.
tag.empty: No looks with this tag yet. Add it to your next caption.
post.report_confirm: Report this look? Three reports hide it until we look at it.
post.delete_confirm: Delete this look? The photo goes private again.
post.hidden_hint: This look was reported and is hidden until we look at it.
post.featured_toast: Featured. The creator has been told.
post.title: Look
comments.title: Comments
comments.empty: No comments yet. Say something kind.
check.title: Where is this outfit going?
check.occasion_placeholder: Dinner with friends, first day at a new job…
check.photo_hint: Tap to take or choose a photo
check.intent_locked: Any intent works; the crowd decides what fits.
check.private_note: The check is private. You decide afterwards whether to post it.
result.title: Your check
result.share_text: My outfit scored {score}/10 for {intent} on OREVOSH. The one tip: {tip}
result.not_outfit_title: That doesn't look like an outfit
result.not_outfit_body: Try a photo where the clothes are clearly visible, ideally full length in good light.
result.rejected_body: Try a different photo of an outfit.
result.post_intro: The photo, the intent, the score and the headline go public. The tip and the breakdown stay yours.
result.caption: Caption
result.caption_hint: Add #tags so people find it, @mention the brands you're wearing, and a challenge's hashtag enters it.
challenges.title: Challenges
challenges.no_winner: No entries, so no winner this time.
challenges.no_entries: No entries yet. Be the first.
challenges.intro: A brand picks a hashtag and a prize. Post a look with the hashtag to enter; the crowd votes and the winner is picked when time's up.
newchallenge.title: Open a challenge
newchallenge.name: Title
newchallenge.brief_placeholder: What should the looks show? Keep it specific.
newchallenge.prize_placeholder: A shirt of the winner's choice
newchallenge.hint: Runs between 1 hour and 60 days. Anyone who posts with the hashtag is in; the crowd votes; the winner is fixed automatically when it ends.
activity.title: Activity
activity.empty: Nothing yet. Post a look and see what happens.
activity.ended_empty: Your challenge ended with no entries
profile.no_posts_me: Your looks show up here. Check one and post it.
profile.community_empty: Looks that mention @{handle} show up here.
profile.community_hint: Mention @{handle} in a caption and your look joins this wall.
profile.featured_empty_brand: Feature community looks that mention you and they show up here.
profile.featured_empty_person: Looks a brand featured show up here.
settings.title: Settings
settings.brand_hint: Brands get a Community wall of every look that mentions them, can feature the ones they love, and tag products on their own looks. Running a hashtag challenge with a prize is optional.
settings.delete: Delete my account and all photos
settings.delete_confirm: Delete your account, every check, every look and every photo? This can't be undone.
saved.title: Saved looks
saved.empty: Save looks you want to come back to. Only you see this.
checks.title: My checks
checks.empty: Your checks will show up here.
pwa.install_title: Add OREVOSH to your home screen
pwa.install_body: It opens full screen, like an app.
pwa.install_ios: Tap Share, then "Add to Home Screen".
pwa.offline: You're offline. Showing what we have.
error.network: Couldn't reach OREVOSH. Check your connection and try again.
error.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
error.image_read: Couldn't read that photo. Try another one.
auth.brand_hint: Brands get a Community wall, can feature looks and tag products.
check.entering_hint: Keep {tag} in your caption and this look is in.
newchallenge.tag_hint: Looks posted with this hashtag while the challenge is open are the entries. Letters, numbers and underscores.
